value.rationale: The result determines the sign and amplitude of the first nonlinear current response exactly for the minimal reflection-asymmetric open site-trap exclusion chain at equal half-density reservoirs. It converts a qualitatively predicted and approximately calculated effect into a sharp model-specific criterion valid at every positive defect rate, with a rigorous size obstruction and a standalone exact certificate. No thermodynamic-limit or broad device universality is claimed.
